# Game Idea: Space Junk Escape

**Genre:** Endless runner / arcade
**Controls:** Arrow keys or WASD to steer a small spaceship.
**Goal:** Fly forward through an endless field of scrolling space debris, collect power‑ups for speed boosts.
**Lose Condition:** Colliding with any piece of debris reduces shields; when shields reach zero the ship is destroyed and the game ends.
**Why HTML Canvas?** Simple 2‑D sprites, continuous scrolling background, and collision detection are easy to implement on a canvas.

1: // Simple endless‑runner game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   let bgAudioStarted = false;
7:   const bgAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // short silent placeholder
8:   bgAudio.loop = true;
9:   bgAudio.volume = 0.1;
10:   function startAudio() {
11:     if (!bgAudioStarted) {
12:       bgAudio.play().catch(() => {});
13:       bgAudioStarted = true;
14:     }
15:   }
16:   function playCollision() {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
20:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(250, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     osc.start();
24:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
25:   }
26:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
27:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
28:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
29:   // Set canvas dimensions (fallback to 800×600)
30:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
31:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
32:   // initialize stars for background
33:   initStars();
34: 
35:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
36:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
37:   const DEBRIS_SIZE = 20;
38:   const DEBRIS_SPEED = 3;
39:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
40:   const MAX_SHIELDS = 3;
41: 
42:   const stars = [];
43:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
44:   function initStars() {
45:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
46:       stars.push({
47:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
48:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
49:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
50:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
51:       });
52:     }
53:   }
54:   function drawStars() {
55:     ctx.save();
56:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
57:     stars.forEach(s => {
58:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
59:       ctx.beginPath();
60:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
61:       ctx.fill();
62:     });
63:     ctx.restore();
64:   }
65: 
66:   const player = {
67:     x: canvas.width / 5,
68:     y: canvas.height / 2 - PLAYER_SIZE / 2,
69:     w: PLAYER_SIZE,
70:     h: PLAYER_SIZE,
71:     shields: MAX_SHIELDS,
72:   };
73: 
74:   const keys = { ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false, ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, w: false, a: false, s: false, d: false };
75:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
76:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
77:     // start background audio on first user interaction
78:     if (!bgAudioStarted) startAudio();
79:   });
80:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
81:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
82:   });
83: 
84:   const debris = [];
85:   let lastSpawn = 0;
86:   let gameOver = false;
87: 
88:   function spawnDebris() {
89:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - DEBRIS_SIZE);
90:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
91:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // rad per frame
92:     debris.push({ x: canvas.width, y, w: DEBRIS_SIZE, h: DEBRIS_SIZE, angle, rotSpeed });
93:   }
94: 
95:   function update(dt) {
96:     // move stars for parallax effect
97:     stars.forEach(s => {
98:       s.x -= 0.5; // speed
99:       if (s.x < 0) {
100:         s.x = canvas.width;
101:         s.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
102:         s.alpha = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5;
103:       }
104:     });
105:     // player movement
106:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED;
107:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) player.y += PLAYER_SPEED;
108:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
109:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
110:     // keep inside canvas
111:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - player.w, player.x));
112:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - player.h, player.y));
113: 
114:     // debris movement
115:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
116:       const d = debris[i];
117:       d.x -= DEBRIS_SPEED;
118:       // collision detection
119:       if (
120:         d.x < player.x + player.w &&
121:         d.x + d.w > player.x &&
122:         d.y < player.y + player.h &&
123:         d.y + d.h > player.y
124:       ) {
125:         playCollision();
126:         player.shields--;
127:         debris.splice(i, 1);
128:         if (player.shields <= 0) {
129:           gameOver = true;
130:         }
131:         continue;
132:       }
133:       // remove off‑screen debris
134:       if (d.x + d.w < 0) debris.splice(i, 1);
135:     }
136: 
137:     // spawn new debris
138:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
139:       spawnDebris();
140:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
141:     }
142:   }
143: 
144:   function draw() {
145:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
146:     // background: starfield with gradient
147:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
148:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
149:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000020');
150:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
151:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
152:     // draw stars
153:     drawStars();
154:     // player ship (white triangle)
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:     ctx.beginPath();
157:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h / 2);
158:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y);
159:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
160:     ctx.closePath();
161:     ctx.fill();
162:     // debris (rotating red squares)
163:     debris.forEach(d => {
164:       ctx.save();
165:       ctx.translate(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2);
166:       ctx.rotate(d.angle || 0);
167:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
168:       ctx.fillRect(-d.w / 2, -d.h / 2, d.w, d.h);
169:       ctx.restore();
170:       // update rotation for next frame
171:       d.angle = (d.angle + d.rotSpeed) % (Math.PI * 2);
172:     });
173:     // shields display
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
175:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
176:     ctx.fillText('Shields: ' + player.shields, 10, 20);
177:   }
178: 
179:   let lastTime = 0;
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
182:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
183:     lastTime = timestamp;
184:     if (!gameOver) {
185:       update(dt);
186:       draw();
187:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:     } else {
189:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
190:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
191:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
192:     }
193:   }
194: 
195:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196: })();

(End of file - total 196 lines)
